answer: Proposal: a buyer signs a lantern job ID and prepays its escrow before dawn. Proposed validators check a signed delivery, extinguish that ID’s ember bit, and pay one worker only from the escrow, never per key. A farm can share one model and self-order jobs, but each extra paid clone needs another funded ID; self-orders return its own money minus a nonrefundable audit fee, and loans cannot create outside demand. An unfunded or reused ID earns zero. This replaces key-based issuance; MinePoA does not enforce it today.
